reason: In app/models/topic_embed.rb:13, url is interpolated unescaped into single-quoted #{url}, and app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 creates the post with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], causing Post#cook at app/models/post.rb:133 to return raw unsanitized HTML that is rendered raw in templates. Because Ruby's URI(url) permits single quotes and attribute characters (e.g. in a query or fragment on embeddable_host via app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:9), a crafted embed_url breaks out of the href attribute and injects event-handler attributes (stored XSS).
